name.zh: 银杏 — 分裂扇叶短枝

author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Fossil-informed Ginkgo yimaensis organ-level display: divided fan leaves and an author-reconstructed compact short shoot. Four leaves, pose, green/brown palette and nominal dimensions are artistic; not a whole tree or a complete preserved branch specimen.
description.zh: 化石证据启发的 Ginkgo yimaensis 器官级展示：分裂扇叶与解释性短枝；四叶数量、姿态、颜色和名义尺寸为创作，不代表完整树木或完整保存的枝条标本。

acceptance_scope: Original frozen source version and bounded independent static review; not whole-world, physical-GPU or user visual approval.
